deadline.value: Graduate applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, with no set deadline.
deadline.quote: For Clarkson University's programs, there are no set deadlines for graduate admissions. Instead, we review applications on a rolling basis.

gre_general.value: The page lists a GRE waiver only for Fall 2023 applicants and gives no rule for Fall 2027.
gre_general.quote: Waived: The GRE requirement will be waived for Fall 2023 applicants.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The page does not say whether a faculty agreement is needed before admission.

funding.value: Only a limited number of tuition scholarships and stipends are offered, mostly tied to assistantships or an MS thesis.
funding.quote: A limited number of one-year and/or partial-year tuition scholarships are available for qualified full-time students.

entry_route.value: The page does not say whether a bachelor's alone is enough; it allows up to 30 credits from a master's.
entry_route.quote: A master’s degree may be accepted in lieu of a maximum of 30 credit hours.

notes: The GRE waiver line is dated Fall 2023; check with graduate admissions for Fall 2027.
